turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
My son learned about a zero from his phone, in class. Was he heard first?
Can I ask your advice as a mom?
No. I asked whether Owen was heard before the zero went in.
My nephew lives with me and lies about homework constantly. How do you get through to a kid like that?
A kid like that. Your nephew is your business, Hale, and he is not my son. On what basis did Owen get a zero?
